name: Wiffleball Legends
detailed_description:
Swing for the Fences and Become a Backyard Hero!

Experience the pure joy and competitive thrill of America's favorite backyard pastime, reimagined with easy and fun to play arcade-style action. Assemble your dream team, master legendary pitches, and become a Wiffleball Legend!

Features:

🏆 EPIC 4v4 ACTION
Fast-paced, strategic gameplay that captures the essence of wiffleball while keeping you on the edge of your seat. Every pitch, swing, and defensive play matters in these compact but intense showdowns!

📜 STORY MODE
Begin your journey as an unknown player with big dreams. Scout and recruit the perfect teammates, each with unique skills and personalities. Navigate rivalries, unexpected challenges, and dramatic moments as your squad battles from local park tournaments to the prestigious National Wiffleball Championship!

⚾ HOME RUN DERBY SHOWDOWNS
Test your power and timing in spectacular derby competitions! Challenge friends or break records in different themed environments.

🏆 SEASON MODE
Manage your team through a full season of strategic decisions. Work your way through the season to ultimately earn the Wiffleball Championship Trophy.

🎮 INTUITIVE CONTROLS, DEEP MECHANICS
Easy to pick up, challenging to master! Perfect the timing of curveballs, knuckleballs, and the legendary "riser" pitch, and more than a dozen other pitch types. On offense, master different swing types to hit for power or precision.

👥 COLORFUL CHARACTER ROSTER
Choose from more than a dozen of unique characters with distinct abilities and stats. From power hitters to defensive wizards, build the perfect team to match your playstyle.

🏟️ FUN PLAYING FIELDS
Compete across varied backyard diamonds, each with unique dimensions and obstacles that change your strategic approach.

Get ready to experience the wiffleball game you've always dreamed of playing!

Wiffleball Legends: Where Backyard Heroes Become Legends

Build your dream team to win a championship in season mode, crush home runs in a home run derby mode and lead your team to the national championship in Story Mode
